site.description: Jasper Cheng-Yen Chan researches visual odometry, 3D mapping, and autonomous UAVs in GPS-denied environments.

homepage.role: Graduate Research Assistant · National Taiwan University
homepage.name: Jasper Cheng-Yen Chan
homepage.intro: I develop **3D computer vision and robot autonomy** methods for localization, 3D mapping, and navigation in challenging environments.
homepage.research_interests: My research spans visual and LiDAR-based localization and mapping, learned correspondence, and safe robot learning. For my PhD, I hope to apply this foundation to socially aware mobile robots that navigate and interact with people in shared spaces.

visual_odometry_for_indoor_uavs.title: Visual odometry for indoor UAVs
visual_odometry_for_indoor_uavs.description: I developed a hybrid visual odometry pipeline using deep feature detectors for GPS-denied flight. Across the EuRoC sequences, mean absolute trajectory error was **50% lower** and mean translational relative pose error was **77% lower** than VINS-Fusion. I also evaluated the system in real indoor UAV flights.
visual_odometry_for_indoor_uavs.caption: Custom UAV platform I designed and assembled for visual odometry experiments.
visual_odometry_for_indoor_uavs.image_alt_2: Indoor UAV flight experiments conducted in a netted safety area
visual_odometry_for_indoor_uavs.caption_2: Indoor flight experiments in the NTU test area.

illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.title: Illumination-robust 3D Gaussian maps
illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.description: I use LiDAR-inertial geometry to build 3D Gaussian maps in dark spaces lit by a moving onboard light. Observations of the same physical points train a **DINOv2-based correspondence encoder**. The map stores separate features for matching and semantic understanding.
illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.description_2: Experiments in real low-light scenes showed that our learned features better distinguish different locations containing objects of the same category than pretrained DINOv2 features. We also tested **map-based pose correction on real UAV flights**. The manuscript is in preparation.
illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.image_alt: Three-stage pipeline: LiDAR-inertial poses and depth initialize a Gaussian map; paired dark images train a correspondence encoder; matching and semantic feature fields are distilled into each scene map
illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.caption: LiDAR-inertial mapping, illumination-robust correspondence learning, and per-scene feature distillation.
illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.image_alt_2: Research UAV equipped with LiDAR and onboard lighting
illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.caption_2: Research UAV equipped with LiDAR and onboard lighting.
illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.image_alt_3: Research UAV flying in a low-light office
illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.caption_3: Indoor UAV flight in a low-light office using onboard illumination.
illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.comparison_image_alt: Cross-view correspondence on a planar surface under changing onboard illumination: Feature-3DGS (LSeg) collapses matches to a few locations, while our learned correspondence field better preserves spatial distinctions.
illumination_robust_3d_gaussian_maps.comparison_caption: Correspondence under changing onboard illumination. Feature-3DGS (LSeg) maps distinct surface points to a few locations, while our learned features better preserve their spatial distinctions.

safe_robot_learning_for_active_3d_recons.title: Safe robot learning for active 3D reconstruction
safe_robot_learning_for_active_3d_recons.description: With collaborators at NTU, we developed a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for monocular 3D reconstruction with a micro aerial vehicle (MAV) in simulated indoor environments. A high-level policy selects viewpoints, while a low-level policy navigates with a control barrier function safety filter. SLAM-aware rewards help maintain visual tracking.
safe_robot_learning_for_active_3d_recons.description_2: In a navigation-policy comparison on unseen simulated layouts, the SLAM-aware variant achieved **88% task success versus 80%** without it, with **7% versus 10% tracking failures**.
safe_robot_learning_for_active_3d_recons.image_alt: Hierarchical RL architecture from the research presentation: a high-level policy selects a viewpoint waypoint and a low-level navigation policy sends actions to a simulated UAV
safe_robot_learning_for_active_3d_recons.caption: High-level viewpoint selection and low-level navigation architecture. This study evaluated the framework in simulation.

global_motion_compensation_for_video.title: Global motion compensation for video
global_motion_compensation_for_video.description: Designed a global motion compensation system for video sequences with camera motion, exploring how alignment can reduce temporal redundancy between frames.
global_motion_compensation_for_video.image_alt: Feature correspondences between two street-scene video frames for global motion compensation
global_motion_compensation_for_video.caption: Example frame correspondences from my project presentation.

construction_progress_from_schedules_and.title: Construction progress monitoring from schedules and images
construction_progress_from_schedules_and.description: Built a research framework to align construction schedules with site images. I used part-of-speech tagging and text preprocessing to extract floor and object information from progress documents, then trained LSTM and BERT models to classify schedule activities for progress analysis.

window_view_evaluation_in_vr.title: Window view evaluation in VR
window_view_evaluation_in_vr.description: Developed interactive indoor environments in Unity with C# to study how different urban window views affect perception and preference. Participants carried out comparable tasks across the simulated scenes.
window_view_evaluation_in_vr.image_alt: Unity virtual room with a large window showing an urban street scene
window_view_evaluation_in_vr.caption: One of the window-view scenes in the Unity simulation.

dementia_risk_evaluation_for_nursing_car.project_index: AI and data science intern · Smart Ageing Tech · 2022
dementia_risk_evaluation_for_nursing_car.title: Dementia risk evaluation for nursing care
dementia_risk_evaluation_for_nursing_car.description: Developed a Random Forest model using nursing notes and resident records to estimate dementia risk. I compared model variants, achieved 94% accuracy on the reported test set, and deployed the model through an API for use in nursing software.
dementia_risk_evaluation_for_nursing_car.caption: Project workflow adapted from my 2022 internship presentation.
